title: Fukuzyu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. — FDA Form 483 (실사 종료 2024-01-19)

evidence.quote: Shared production equipment is not always cleaned and maintained in a manner suitable to prevent cross­ contamination of non-hazardous API by hazardous substances.
